220390101.text: This is no way to continue doing business...

220390103.text: Ah, I'm sorry. I was just a little lost in my own thoughts. Are you here to buy some clothes?

220390104.text: The high-class silks from Liyue remain out of stock, but we still have the latest kimonos.

220390105.text: You used to import material from Liyue?

220390106.text: Yes. Before, we were often able to secure high-end silk from Liyue such as those that the Feiyun Commerce Guild makes from Silk Flowers.

220390107.text: But with the current situation here, we haven't been able to import that sort of silk in a while now. We've been having to rely on our existing stock to continue operations.

220390108.text: Every bolt of silk we use here is one we're not getting back...

220390109.text: I originally planned to design some novel kimono patterns myself, or use some new dyes to make new cloth and attract customers.

220390110.text: But I've been unable to come up with anything that might be considered "new" dyes...

220390111.text: Considering your many journeys, Traveler, I'm sure you've seen a great deal. Have you encountered any dye-work that you might consider "novel"?

220390114.text: If you could, please help me broaden my horizons. Find me some base materials from which I can might new types of dye.

220390115.text: I will take care of the payment. Again, thank you so much!

220390117.text: In these circumstances, I think that's the only thing I can do at the moment...

220390118.text: If you know of any such base material that can be used to make "new" dyes, please bring them to me. I'll arrange for the necessary payment.

subQuests.subQuestName: Give the appropriate dye ingredients to Ogura Mio

220390401.text: Ah, so that's what you've brought. Yes, yes, I do think that these colors will be quite the novelty indeed.

220390402.text: Thanks so much for getting me these, Traveler. I'll give them a try in a moment — please take this as compensation for your efforts.

220390403.text: I wonder what colors we'll be able to get...

220390501.text: Th—these... Are you sure that these can be used in dyes? I can't say I've ever heard of them...

220390502.text: O—Oh well, I suppose I'll just give it a go. Here, Traveler, take these as a token of my appreciation...

220390301.text: Have you found any suitable base materials?
